title: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
summary: The HP HyperX Omen 15, which I first saw at CES , replaces the HP Victus 15 , a longtime bestselling budget gaming laptop. The HyperX Omen 15 is a decent gaming laptop.
